summary: 18 month old for ear tubes by mask induction without IV, three weeks after a URI, with secondhand smoke exposure. Fasting is appropriate. Teaching case for pediatric airway planning; outside the adult engine range.

decision.rationale: URI resolved 3 weeks ago with no current symptoms; fasting times meet guidelines (formula over 6 h, clears over 1 to 2 h).

redFlags.finding: Recent URI and passive smoke exposure
redFlags.evidence: URI early October; father smokes outside; daycare.
redFlags.implication: Higher risk of laryngospasm and desaturation for several weeks.
redFlags.action: Deep plane before airway stimulation, suction ready, CPAP for laryngospasm.
Have IM succinylcholine and atropine drawn up, IV supplies ready.

planItems.item: Sevoflurane mask induction with parent present to OR door
